name: Cloudscape
fit: Dense admin consoles, dashboards, and wizards.
principles: Content first. One primary action per view. Density is high and consistent. Help text sits next to the decision.
color: A cool neutral canvas with a single action blue. Status colors for error, warning, success, and info.
typography: A compact product scale. Page headers are larger than section headers. Body stays small.
spacing: A tight spacing scale for forms, tables, and wizards.
shape: Small radii on containers and controls.
elevation: Flash, modal, and dropdown are the elevated layers. The page itself is flat.
layout: App layout with side navigation, content, split panel, and a wizard or form layout.
icons: A small functional icon set sized for 16px controls.
components: App layout, table, form, form field, wizard, flashbar, modal, and side navigation.
adapt: Keep the app layout, the form density, and the one-primary-action rule. Replace the AWS blue and any console chrome that is not this product.
